what: A screen-height photo cell is pinned for (photo count − 1) screens, and at each step the next photo covers it rising from the bottom edge as a clipped area (clip-path inset 100%→0%) while that photo moves 0→−10% and the previous photo is pushed a further −10% up and out (tied directly to scroll, no curve). The side cell (title column) is also pinned for the same span. On enter, while the cell comes up from the bottom of the screen, the first photo turns on 0→1 and shifts −10%

options.dur: Length (seconds) that follows the scroll value, default 0 — the original bar section and About photo slot follow slightly late at .1
options.enter: If true, while the cell slides in the first photo fades 0→1 and is pushed −push% (follows at .1s)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo frame to pin (screen height). Inside it, [data-fx-part=media] are covered one after another — two or more
options.[data-fx-part=side]: (If present) side column to pin together — the title row of the half-and-half section

use: Title
note: The original pins the same photo frame one after another with two ScrollTriggers (two empty 100vh blocks added, pinSpacing false) and shifts values per step — the part leaves spacing to ScrollTrigger and produces the same values with a single pin.

from.where: index.html .kc-detail--a (enter, dur 0 — restaurant) · .kc-detail--b (enter, dur .1 — bar) · about.html .kc-pict (dur .1, full-width photo slot)

index.html·service.html pinned project stacking .tw-projects — push: 4; dur: .12 (original scrub .12). In the original the first photo moves down 0→+4% during entry, which differs from enter (turns on with −push), and the text for the current number changes 200ms late, using the cell obtained by flooring progress × (section count−1) + .65 — this exists only in the site code
